SELECT r.region, AVG(CASE WHEN CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS DATE) > CAST(o.order_estimated_delivery_date AS DATE) THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS late_rate FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN regions r ON r.state = c.customer_state WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2017-05-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2017-06-01' GROUP BY 1

WITH m AS (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2017-05-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2017-06-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS prev, SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2017-06-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2017-07-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cur FROM orders o) SELECT (cur - prev) * 1.0 / NULLIF(prev, 0) AS growth FROM m

SELECT COUNT(*) AS active_sellers FROM (SELECT i.seller_id FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN sellers s ON s.seller_id = i.seller_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2018-06-02' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2018-09-01' AND s.seller_state = 'GO' GROUP BY 1)

SELECT p.category_en FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2017-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2017-04-01' AND p.category_en IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY SUM(i.price) DESC LIMIT 5
